summary:
Opened the Neon Runner demo project and selected the player object.
Opened the agent panel, switched it to Build mode, and sent: “Give the player a double jump.”
The chat confirmed that the change was applied, and the player’s Air jumps setting changed from 0 to 1.
Tested the change in Play mode: after two Space presses while airborne, the player performed a second jump.
Stopped Play mode and used Undo once; Air jumps returned to 0.
oneLiner: tested and reverted a player double-jump change on the Neon Runner project
